investigation: Audit changes after public 0.7.2, including 640x480 adapters, geometry allocation and generated text uploads.
Private Flycast approximation enables framebuffer/render-to-texture emulation, interpreter CPU and ordinary GD-ROM timing. This does not establish physical compatibility.
Inspect the existing native cache-flush routine: it rounds the start down and covers partial cache lines. No cache-flush defect has been established.
Do not infer that rectangular VQ is the cause simply from the SDK's original admission check. The diagnostic below tests the runtime compression feature as a whole.
DCP conversion audio differences are DAT/format silence padding. Non-silent CDDA content and four-byte sample alignment match; no audio corruption is established.

2026-10-29: execute unchanged SDK layout code against saved 320x240 and 640x480 states. At the same reservation, the graphics-list growth interval shrinks from 78,720 to 31,104 bytes. An unbuilt reserve adjustment restores it, but its extra 380,928 bytes exceed known Stage 6 bank-0 free space; do not blindly ship that change as a fix.

2026-10-30: public 0.7.11 also fails with both fonts and New Game, so neither the 0.7.22 codec nor the 0.7.19 list-growth reduction alone explains all reports. Prepare stock-rendering diagnostic 0.7.25; no hardware fix claimed.
